TITLE: Part Sale – Status Card Has No Technician or Sales Representative Field
TYPE: Story Defect · PARENT: (owning story to confirm — regression item) · PRIORITY: Medium · LABEL: board-tech-view
MY READING: PROBABLY NOT A DEFECT — part sales have no technician field to change; the developer note assumed one.

h2. Description

A part sale's *status card* should let the user change its person (technician / Sales Representative).

For example,
* the card shows Contact, Phone, Authorizer and Asset
* there is no technician or Sales Representative field

h2. Steps to Reproduce

# Open *Parts* > *Part Sales* and open a part sale.
# Look at the status card at the left.
#* It shows Contact, Phone, Authorizer and Asset only.

*Actual Result:*
* No technician or Sales Representative field on the part sale status card.

*Expected Result:*
* The person can be changed on the card and the change is kept after a reload.
